**Radstag Stew** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A spiced stew made from Radstag Meat and Tatos. When consumed, it temporarily increases Energy Resistance by 35.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Radstag Meat (2) Spices (1) Tato (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Radstag Stew | | Radstag Stew (1) | 

- Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients and after having learned the Recipe.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.
- May be bought from Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
